name: Incline push-up
summary: Hands on a raised surface, body straight, lower the chest to it and press away.
setup: Hands on a bench or table edge, side-on to the phone, body one line from head to heels. Lower the chest toward the edge and press back up.
brief: Hands on a bench or table edge, body one line from head to heels. Lower the chest toward the edge and press back up.
why: From the side the elbow angle closes and opens each rep, so reps are counted. The body line is listed, not judged, because the bench often hides the hip.
progression: Lower surface, down to the floor.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.tip: Brace so the body stays one line.

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.tip: The plank line matters as much here as on the floor.

faults.label: Cutting depth
faults.tip: Touch the chest to the surface each rep.

faults.label: Surface too high
faults.cue: Lower surface when it is easy
faults.tip: The higher the hands, the easier it is. Lower the surface as you get stronger.

guide.cannotSee: The hips when the bench is in the way.
